title: 2015 AMC 12A Problem 2
statement: Two of the three sides of a triangle are \(20\) and \(15.\) Which of the following numbers is not a possible perimeter of the triangle?

solutions.text:
By the Triangle Inequality, the third side \(s\) satisfies \(20-15 \lt s \lt 20+15,\) that is \(5 \lt s \lt 35.\)

The perimeter is \(35 + s,\) so it lies strictly between \(40\) and \(70.\) Among the choices, only \(72\) falls outside this range.

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: The third side lies strictly between \(20-15\) and \(20+15\)
Add \(20+15\) to that range to bound the perimeter
